digest.component_or_area: per-class LLM fallback model construction in rebar/llm
propositions: A class naming an unreachable model fails the gate outright with no way to fall back to an alternative model.
Consume the parsed inline fallback config to build a per-class pydantic-ai FallbackModel whose default is the primary entry, leaving classes without fallback unwrapped.

fallback_on is a callable predicate derived from failure.py's _RETRYABLE frozenset plus CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL, so it fires on transport errors, 429/529/5xx but not on 401/403, 400 context-length, or insufficient_quota 429.
Capabilities are computed as the conservative intersection over all resolved candidate model objects before the wrapper is built, since capabilities_for on a FallbackModel silently returns defaults.

provider_provenance records the ordered candidates and reads ran_model from the answering ModelResponse.model_name rather than the synthetic FallbackModel.model_name, so a fallback verdict does not attest the primary.

The FallbackModel must be used as an async context manager so its sub-providers are entered/exited, while rebar-created transports remain closed via ProviderSession._closeables exactly once without double-close.
